facts.claim: Mein Schiff 1 (TUI Cruises): Entered service 2018; 111,500 GT; 2850 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 290 m length; Mein Schiff 1 class.

Two ships have been named Mein Schiff 1,Mein Schiff 1 (2010) launched in 1996, served under this name between 2010 and 2018
Mein Schiff 1 (2018) launched in 2018
